Master Degree in Informatics Engineering and Computation

The education in Informatics Engineering and Computation was conceived at FEUP as requiring a complete formation cycle and teaching of 5 years, that match the 1st and 2nd cycles of the Bologna Process specification and which confere immediatelly the Master Degree.

 By the end of the first 3 years (1st cycle) of MIEIC, the students are provided with a solid formation basis, that compose the essential scientific and engineering competences as well as the fundamental knowledge in the various informatics areas, although not yet with any specialised field. This first step is mostly seen as an enabler of mobility to or from any other national or international school.

 By the end of the 5 years of this degree, the graduates will have and advanced education in Informatics Engineering and Computation, having been given the choice of a specialisation area or a wider array of interests, since there is a varied offer in terms of options, individually configured, in the degree program.

 The possible specialisations include, at present:
 - Software Engineering and Information Systems (2 sub-areas)

 - Networks and Information Technologies (Internet Technologies and Informatics Infraestructure sub-areas)

 - Intelligent Systems and Multimedia (2 sub-areas)
Licenciate (Bachelor) Degree in Informatics Engineering and Master Degree in Informatics Engineering

The Degree in Informatics Engineering has the main goal of providing the future undergraduates the basic principles, theories, methods and practices of the Informatics Engineering and Computation in a way that they are able to master all the concepts for their intervention on society or complement their education with the 2nd cycle, following a professional life or a scientific career. In order to achieve this general goal, the current cycle of studies aims to concile the following specific objectives: instrumental, systemic and interpersonal.

 - At the instrumental level, it is expected that the undergraduates in Informatics Engineering acquire skills to articulate in an harmonious was the complementarity between analysis and synthesis, that they deeped the problem resolution dynamics, learn the logics and practices of information management and pursue the exercise of these competencies according to organisational planning approaches centered in the construction of value to clients and transformation of complexity in performance.
 - At systemic level, its goal is to improve the students autonomy and ability to learn, their adaptability to new situations, their correct application of knowledge and competencies and to tailor their mindsets towards quality and excellence.
 - Finally, at interpersonal level, it is expected that the students acquire other kinds of skills that contribute to the development of their personal and civic skills, their ability to autonomously acquire knowledge, their critical thinking and responsibility, information management, teamwork and multidisciplinary teams, collective learning and success construction sense, etc.


The Master Degree in Informatics Engineering proposes 4 areas of specialisation according to the latest curriculum recommendaton by the Association for Computer Machinery (ACM) and the Institute for Electrical and Electronic Engineers (IEEE):
 - Comunications, Services and Infrastructures
 - Intelligent Systems
 - Information Systems
 - Software Engineering


It is then proposed the creation of speacilisations in order to answer the needs of the market, both at industry and services level, as well as investigation, so that this degree can have an international impact in the mid-run.
